intro: Online bingo with friends and family.

create-room.title: Create a room
create-room.error: We couldn't create the room. Try again.
create-room.success: Room created. You can now set it up.

description: Play for free, with no sign-up or downloads. Create a room and share the bingo cards to play together.

prepare.title: Set up the room
prepare.description: Create a room, add the names of everyone playing and choose a host.

share.title: Share the link
share.description: When the game is ready, share the room link. Each person finds their name and selects "Play" to open their two bingo cards.

play.title: Call numbers and mark your cards
play.description: The host draws numbers from 1 to 90. Each person marks matching numbers on their own cards.

free.question: Is it free? Do I need to sign up?
free.answer: Yes, it is free and no account is needed. Play in your phone or computer browser.

join.question: Do I need to create a room to join?
join.answer: No. Use the shared room link. The person setting up the room needs to add your name before starting the game.

draw.question: Can we use a physical bingo cage?
draw.answer: Yes. Turn off "Use online bingo caller" when setting up the room, then record the drawn numbers on the number board. When enabled, the app randomly chooses the next number at the host's request.

remote.question: Can we play remotely?
remote.answer: Yes. Each person plays on their own device. To see and talk to each other, use a separate video call, such as <0>Google Meet</0>.
